headline: Vivimed Labs Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Vivimed Labs Limited, a listed pharmaceutical company, has formally entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the IBC 2016. The company notified the NSE of the CIRP commencement on 17 June 2026.
detail: Vivimed Labs Limited notified the National Stock Exchange (NSE) of the commencement of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process on 17 June 2026, per the NSE archives filing 'Updates_to_CIRP.pdf'. The CIRP is the statutory insolvency resolution mechanism under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, typically initiated following an admission order by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). During CIRP, an Insolvency Professional assumes management of the corporate debtor and creditors file claims toward a resolution plan or liquidation outcome within a 180-day statutory window (extendable by 90 days).
